coarse_skill_concept: Building a scikit-learn training pipeline, logging metrics and artifacts to an experiment tracker, and serializing the trained model for later inference.

task_judgments.reason: The task is entirely about spinning up an MLflow server, using mlflow.sklearn.log_model, and registering the model in the MLflow model registry — the experiment-tracker portion of the candidate skill is the core requirement.

The task uses sklearn and pickle serialization but has no experiment tracker step; instead it requires real CSV ingestion, SHA-256 checksum generation, specific feature selection, an accuracy threshold, and a coefficient-sign constraint — none of which are part of the candidate skill.
